description: This file defines schema-related utility functions to create and manage string enum types and channel target schemas using the '@sinclair/typebox' library. It includes functions to generate string enums, optional string enums, and schemas for channel targets and arrays of channel targets, with references to external constants for descriptions.

methods.name: export function stringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( stringEnum
methods.description: Creates a string enum schema using the provided array of values, with optional description, title, and default. Ensures only string values are used and constructs the schema via Type.Unsafe.

methods.name: export function optionalStringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Wraps 'stringEnum' to create an optional schema for the string enum.

methods.name: export function channelTargetSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetSchema
methods.description: Creates a string schema for a channel target, optionally with a custom description or a default from external constants.

methods.name: export function channelTargetsSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetsSchema
methods.description: Creates an array schema of channel targets, with descriptions sourced from external constants.
